Photography and brand assets

The Kerala Section SIGHT logo was supplied by the team on 19 September 2026. Browser and home-screen icons use the same artwork.

Photographs are historical documentary images, not representations of current events or current office holders. No AI-generated community photographs are used.

2026 leadership and contact

The professional and student leadership names, roles and portraits were supplied by the Kerala SIGHT team through its three 2026 leadership announcements. The contact address ieeekerala.sight@gmail.com was supplied alongside these announcements on 18 September 2026. The contact page prepares an email in the visitor’s mail application; it does not submit or store enquiries.

Design assets

The Kerala landscapes, streetlight and electronics workspace are AI-generated conceptual illustrations created for this design. They do not document actual project sites or participants. Project cards and story panels distinguish illustrations from project photography.

Typography: DM Sans and Instrument Serif, self-hosted from Google Fonts under the SIL Open Font License. Icons: Phosphor Icons, MIT licence. No third-party font or icon requests are made at runtime.

The previous SIGHT Hub

The discussion archive and sign-in links lead to the existing external website. Its content and member accounts have not been migrated into this website. Some older pages contain outdated or unrelated material; only verified information is included here.
